info.title: API.SH: Flashscore
info.description: The Flashscore API from API.SH: public Flashscore data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every match in progress for a sport, with live score, score by period, stage and tournament.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flashscore-live

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport (default football).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One match: both teams (id, name, logo), score and score by period, status and stage, start time, tournament with its tournament and stage ids, referee, venue, city, attendance and capacity, and which detail tabs the match has.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flashscore-match

parameters.name: match_id
parameters.description: Flashscore match id or a match link (flashscore.com/match/YceoIxQh/ or .../?mid=YceoIxQh). YceoIxQh = Newcastle v Everton, Premier League, 2 Nov 2026.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every match Flashscore lists for a sport on a day, from 7 days back to 7 days ahead: id, link, start time, status (scheduled, live, finished) and stage (1st half, half time, after penalties ...), both teams (id, name, short name, logo), score and score by period, winner, red cards, round, and the tournament (name, country, tournament, stage and template ids). Filter by status, country or tournament.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flashscore-matches

parameters.name: sport
parameters.description: Sport (default football).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD within 7 days of today (UTC).

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Day offset from today, -7 to 7 (default 0), instead of `date`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only live, finished or scheduled matches.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Only this country or region name (e.g. England, Europe).

parameters.name: tournament_id
parameters.description: Only this tournament, stage or template id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
